title: Well-posedness and regularity for seminlinear time-dependent second and fourth order in space equations
summary: This article discusses a unified convergence analysis of the semilinear time-dependent equation $\partial_t u + (-1)^\mathrm{m}Δ^{\mathrm{m}}u + u^3 - u = f$ with $\mathrm{m} \in \{1,2\}$ and homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. The analysis relies on Faedo-Galerkin approximation and convergence via compactness estimates. The existence and uniqueness of the weak solution is proved when the initial data is smooth. A refined and novel analysis extends the existence result to problems with rough initial data also.
